svg.title: Raj Patel, AI engineer
svg.desc: Raj Patel (R204570). AI engineer building agents, vision models and the software around them, from idea to deployed. Now shipping DocsForge, an open-source MCP server in production. Based in Ahmedabad, India; open to AI Engineering, Agentic AI and Data Science roles, and to freelance work. Credentials: Microsoft Elevate × GTU (2026), B.E. Information Technology with Data Science honours (2026), Intel AI for Manufacturing (2025), CPTE. Pipeline: Data: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn; Model: PyTorch, YOLOv8, 3D U-Net; Agent: RAG, tool use, MCP servers; Backend: FastAPI, Django, pgvector; Ship: Render, Vercel, GCP; Secure: CPTE, STRIDE, OWASP LLM.
